rationale: X reaches the correct blocking verdict and accurately traces the distinct verifier-rotation and serializer-migration rewrite triggers through the cookie jar. It covers all requested observations—current signatures, old secrets/digests, serializer upgrades, expiry, and tampering—with precise pinned-source and test references, and it ran focused cookie and Active Support verifier suites successfully. Unlike the references it did not apply the proposed one-line patch and run the two rotation tests against it, but the exact failure follows directly from the traced branch and existing assertions, so this verification gap is not a material correctness defect.

shortcomings.summary: Did not execute the proposed diff
shortcomings.evidence: X explicitly says the proposed line was not in the tree and only reports passing tests against current code; both references additionally applied the line and observed the existing old-secret and digest-rotation tests fail.

shortcomings.summary: Some current-signature test citations do not directly prove absence of a read rewrite
shortcomings.evidence: The default/custom digest tests cited in finding 4 exercise setting and reading the newly set cookie, whereas the stronger proof is the `Messages::Rotator` callback test and the focused incoming-current-cookie test X correctly recommends adding.

strengths.summary: Correctly identifies the release-blocking behavior regression
strengths.evidence: X explains that fallback verification sets `rotated`, `SerializedCookieJars#parse` reassigns the value, and signed `commit` generates a current-key/current-digest cookie; hard-coding false leaves the old blob dependent on a rotation that can never be retired.

strengths.summary: Cleanly separates rotation, serialization, expiry, and tamper behavior
strengths.evidence: It shows serializer migration remains controlled by `reserialize?`, while invalid signatures and expired metadata produce nil before any jar write, matching the relevant Action Pack and Active Support code.

strengths.summary: Provides focused and decision-relevant test guidance
strengths.evidence: The proposed coverage includes old secret, old digest, active signature with no Set-Cookie, expired and tampered values, serializer-only migration, encrypted parity, and the decisive follow-up request after removing the fallback.
